summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Meta Ads Manager dashboard. All features working perfectly including layout, data persistence, inline editing, create/edit drawers, JSON editor, and table scrolling.
passed_tests: Dashboard loads without red screen or console errors
All layout elements present: left sidebar, right dark rail, top bar, filter bar, search placeholder 'Describe what you're looking for', campaign/adset/ads tabs, toolbar, table
Date defaults to 'Today: 19 Sep 2026' format and is editable via hidden date input
Initial 9 campaigns render with exact names: our ads, ps5 tukka, test - Copy 8, test - Copy 7, test - Copy 6, test - Copy 5, test - Copy 4, test - Copy 2, test - Copy
All 9 campaigns start Active with all toggles checked/on
Toggle functionality works: toggling off changes Delivery to 'Off', toggling on changes back to 'Active'
Inline table editing works for campaign name, results, budget, amount spent, impressions and all other fields
localStorage persistence works: inline edits survive page reload via meta_ads_rows_v3 key
Date editing works and persists via meta_ads_date_v1 key
Create button adds new campaign row, opens full campaign detail editor drawer with 'Create campaign' title, saving updates table, new row persists after reload
Edit button opens full detail editor for selected row with 'Edit campaign' title, all visible fields editable, saving updates table
JSON table data editor works: opens drawer, allows JSON editing, applies changes to table, persists via localStorage
Table supports horizontal and vertical scrolling with sticky header
Sticky left columns (select, toggle, campaign) remain visible during horizontal scroll
